identitySignals: Name matches exactly: the website acreducators.org identifies itself as the Association of Community Rehabilitation Educators (ACRE)

ACRE works in employment services for people with disabilities, consistent with OUSD's special education contract and the 'ACRE Basic Customized Employment Services' funding source (inferred, not confirmed by a page linking ACRE to California or OUSD)
research.notes: Web search quota was exhausted, so no registry (ProPublica, CA SOS, SAM.gov) or independent page could be checked, and ProPublica returned HTTP 429. ACRE is a Colorado-based national association; no page found links it to California, the DDS Quality Incentive Program or OUSD. Email on the site is obfuscated. Needs a human check or re-run with search available before publishing.

profile.summary: A national membership organization for trainers and educators in the field of employment for people with disabilities. It offers professional development, endorsement of training curricula, and certification for people who work in community employment services.
